description.value:
Activate 2 Strike

A spellgun with no spell in it yet. When it first goes into a creature's inventory, it asks the one who put it there which spell it mimics and at what rank, and becomes a spellgun of that spell: its name, level and price are a spellgun's of that rank (a scroll's price).

You Activate a loaded spellgun by aiming it at one creature and making your choice of a spell attack roll or a firearm attack roll against the target's AC. It has a range increment of 30 feet. A hit affects only the target, as if it had failed its save against the spell (for a spell that makes a spell attack, as the spell's hit does), and a critical hit as if it had critically failed (the spell's critical hit); a spell with neither deals its damage on a hit and double on a critical hit. Then the spellgun crumbles.
